title: Merge BSTs to Create Single BST
summary: Given an array of n BST root nodes, each with at most 3 nodes, you can merge two distinct BSTs by replacing a leaf node in one BST with another BST.
statement: Given an array of n BST root nodes, each with at most 3 nodes, you can merge two distinct BSTs by replacing a leaf node in one BST with another BST. Perform n-1 operations to form a single valid BST, or return null if impossible. A BST must satisfy the property that all left children are less and all right children are greater than their parent. A leaf node has no children.
constraints: trees contains 1 through 50000 distinct BST roots.
Each input tree has at most three nodes and no grandchildren.
Root values are unique; leaf values may name roots of other trees.
Graft a matching root at a leaf and return one valid BST using every input tree, or None if impossible.
